brief.name: Tidebreak
brief.pitch: Swap glowing sea glass to clear a bright tide pool and rescue baby sea turtles hidden beneath the tiles in this wholesome, free-to-play match-3 puzzler.
mechanics: Swap adjacent sea glass tiles to create matches and clear the tide pool
Rescue baby sea turtles that appear under the tiles and free them by clearing the tiles above them
brief.art_style: Bright watercolor ocean with rounded, soft shapes
facts: Tidebreak is a match-3 game for mobile.
Players swap glowing sea glass to clear a tide pool.
Baby sea turtles appear under the tiles and can be rescued.
The game launches with 400 hand-built levels.
The game is free to play with optional ads.
The game can be played offline.
The art style is bright watercolor ocean with rounded shapes.
The tone is playful and wholesome.
not_true: Tidebreak does not offer real-money rewards.
brief.launch_goal: Bring lapsed match-3 players back to the genre with a fresh, wholesome puzzle experience.
